sources.note: Main homepage. States 60M+ lives covered, 38+ states, $622M+ claims processed. Describes integrated EHR, practice management, billing for public and behavioral health.
ONC certification page and mandatory disclosures. Lists EHI export capabilities (single/multi-patient CCDA export, billing data CSV/XLSX/PDF). Links to FHIR API documentation.
Describes target markets: public health departments, behavioral health agencies, federal/statewide solutions, school-based health. 98% client retention.
Details practice management features: scheduling, patient registration, case management, insurance verification, billing, eFax, reporting.
Company background. Founded 2009 by Ashok Mathur, HQ in Cary NC. Certified NC Minority-Owned business. 10x Stevie Award winner for customer service.
EHR feature page. Customizable templates, document upload, vaccine tracking, interoperability with HIEs/labs/registries. Emphasizes public and behavioral health workflows.
MyHealth patient portal features: view records/labs/meds, secure messaging, questionnaires, consent forms, eCheck-in, self-scheduling, automated notifications.

Technology/architecture page. Cloud-based SaaS, web-browser only. Integrates with HIEs, immunization registries, labs (LabCorp, Solstas, Quest). Uses ICD-10, CPT, SNOMED, RxNorm, DSM-5. HL7 2.5.1, HIPAA compliant.
Enterprise features: statewide master patient index, state HIE connectivity, management dashboards, integrated billing, referral tracking, 510+ counties served.
Customer success stories page. References Cleveland County, Beaufort County, Richmond/Stokes County, and Fairfax County health departments.

Third-party review site. Lists features including e-prescribing, telehealth, billing, patient portal. Notes behavioral health templates. Pricing from $500/user/month. Mixed user reviews on performance.

Third-party EMR review. Lists patient portal, e-prescribing, eFax, telehealth, billing. Users describe it as user-friendly but some note outdated interface and navigation issues. Targets small-medium practices.
